mixed.scope: fast: include_groups_ids=-100; slow: no group filter

continuous.submit: all jobs once, no barriers; phase selected by request identity, preserving the same ordered job workload in both comparators
continuous.measure: total wall, per-class timing, constrained first-half and second-half throughput, peak active, reduction and recovery trajectory

limitations: Continuous transition overlaps cohorts; pre-admitted work is not cancellable
Request-defined phases do not implement an internal database scheduler
Every result, including regressions, remains reported
